_rotation_note: rotation is only the fallback when a script has neither "voice" nor "tone"; casting decides (21/11/2026).

casting._doc: Owner 21/11/2026: the voice must fit the topic and be viral, NOT always histrionic. Pick the tone of the story, then a voice from its list (first = default; rotate inside the list for experiments). Write it in script.json as "voice" and the tone as "tone". Never pick by rotation alone.

awe.for: space, the universe, record-breaking science, deep time, huge numbers, quiet 'think about that' facts
awe.delivery: calm, slow, wonder; few or no audio tags; short pauses ([pause]) before the reveal

mystery.for: unsolved cases, creepy true stories, psychology tricks, hidden explanations, secrets
mystery.delivery: low and intimate, [whispers] only on the key line, tension rising; no laughing

insider.for: brands, companies, money, business ideas, how stores/apps trick you, prices
insider.delivery: confident, quick, punchy numbers, dry humor ([chuckles] at most once)

comedy.for: absurd everyday moments, funny food/brand stories, petty human behaviour, EVERYDAY X-RAY situations
comedy.delivery: big personality, regional accent, laughs where it is funny

shock.for: gross body facts, extreme dares, 'you won't believe' records, chaotic history
shock.delivery: theatrical (owner's favourite xr4), roars and whispers

news.for: something that happened in the last 72 h
news.delivery: urgent but credible; match the story: tech/business -> xr12, science/space -> xr10, pop culture -> xr2

story.delivery: storyteller, warm, builds to the twist
